source.title: CFD Approach to Wagner Number Estimation for a Current Distribution Uniformity in a Rotating Cylinder Hull Cell

tag: [AB] abstract + metadata only (full text not retrieved: ijecs.com down, ScienceDirect 403); DOI verified via Crossref + DOAJ

conditions.application: copper electrorefining/electrodeposition, rotating cylinder Hull (RCH) cell
conditions.method: 3D CFD secondary current distribution; Wagner number compared with analytical Tafel-kinetics approximation

data.content: Wagner number Wa = kappa * (deta/dj) / L (Tafel slope form). Paper gives CFD-vs-analytical Wa for RCH geometry; no numeric tables retrieved. Use as method reference for coupon-scale uniformity validation of platesim cell module, not as a data source.

notes: PRIORITY 5 was 'if quickly available' - it was NOT quickly available. This is a metadata-level pointer only. Other potentially useful paywalled leads for uniformity vs Wa: Fairweather 1984 Trans. IMF 62:5 (throwing power of acid copper PCB processes, doi 10.1080/00202967.1984.11870659 [AB]); Dikusar 2005 Russ J Electrochem 41:82 (throwing power dilute H2SO4 copper, doi 10.1007/s11175-005-0009-z [AB]). No digitised thickness-vs-Wa dataset was obtained; the team's own Oct-7 coupon corner-to-corner gradient (KB section 2, +/-16%) remains the primary in-house uniformity datum.
